statements.text: I am running on an integrated plan: restore hundreds of millions of tax dollars stripped from Nevada by Elon Musk and DOGE; develop strong regulations to prevent massive job layoffs due to AI; and build workforce housing that everyday Nevadans can afford.
And I stood up to A.I. companies that put our jobs at risk,
statements.venue: Campaign TV ad "Home Means Nevada", quoted in 2News Reality Check

statements.text: In congress I'll keep data centers from driving up utility bills and draining our water,
statements.venue: Campaign TV ad "Home Means Nevada", quoted in 2News Reality Check

statements.text: I don’t think anyone in 2015 was anticipating AI to be where it is right now,
statements.venue: Quoted in Nevada Globe, from her interview with The Nevada Independent, on data center tax abatements

statements.text: We have to make sure that there’s not a federal law that’s going to be written thinking about Mississippi-level type of water and the type of rainfall they get in other places in the United States,
statements.venue: KOLO 8 News interview on data centers and federal preemption
